main_rule.rule: every cell shows the most recent configuration that measured it; A is newer than B if B's revision is an ancestor of A's (git merge-base --is-ancestor, recorded in milestone.json ancestry) or if A is the development side and B the integrated side of one G1 campaign, transitively; equal revisions keep the order development, integrated, development_records; the registry (no run) comes last; without a measurement, the status of the newest configuration with a record of the row
main_rule.validation_rule: a newer comparison with fewer points or fewer references than an older one and no larger deviation repeats part of it: the older, more complete comparison stays in the cell and the repeat is listed in partial_repeats; a newer comparison with a larger deviation, or at least as many points and every reference, replaces it
main_rule.generation_rule: a generation multiplier pairs values timed under the same kind of conditions: in a G1 row the campaign's provider generation with a G1 configuration; a newer development record there (shared host under load) has no multiplier; in the other rows the development record with the providers' reference runs, both run records on this shared host outside the G1 protocol

decisions.status: no longer applies: the G1 re-measure on loop (4e9b5a9e, native inputs) is a measured pass at B = 128 after its single repeat (0.87 of the limit, band 0.78-0.95); a decision applies to a measured open verdict of its process and batch only

threshold_rule.label: below 5 ms: not gated (user 2026-10-24)
threshold_rule.applies: a process whose pyAmpliCol batched time per point is below 5 ms has no blocking gate: its ratio and band stay as measured and are shown, its verdict is the label, at every batch size of that configuration (B = 1 included); the batched time is the configuration's own at its largest batch above 1, and for a configuration timed at B = 1 only (the one-lane runs) the configuration on loop's; it takes precedence over a decision; the exact-rational vs binary64 input question is therefore moot and the protocol stays
